title: Mary Jo R NDE 3504
content:
Mary Jo's Book: "Is God Pink - Dying to Heal" Click Here Experience Description I saw a light. It appeared small and then grew bigger and encompassed me into it. I was not afraid and very much able to evaluate the light coming toward me. I noted it was not large and then grew larger. I remember 'floating' through this tunnel like thing - and then I just folded out into a huge room - not sure it was a room but it was a space. It was brilliant and had a pink tinge. (Hence the name of the book I later wrote about it titled 'Is God Pink - Dying to Heal''.) God held me - I don't remember if my whole body was in his arms or what - no recognition of that. I knew it was God because he was an omnipotent being. Not like a person - much less limited in form. I did not see God but felt him through my skin. He spoke through all of my senses. He called me by name and told me I could not stay. I protested. I told him all of my services on earth (working 24/7, not much money for my work, a good wife, a good mother) I did not want to leave this place. Then God asked me, He said, 'Let me ask you one question. Have you ever loved another person the way you have been loved here?' The love I had received in that time was so overpowering - I had never felt anything like it so I answered God honestly. I said, 'No, it is impossible, I am just a human, you are God.' He gave me the illusion of a sweet protective chuckle. He then said, 'Mary, you can do better.' I woke up to my husband shaking my arm and crying - telling me I was very sick and they were going to have to take me to surgery. He was telling me they would have to open my head and clip an artery that was bleeding. He told me please not to die. I told my husband not to worry. I had just talked to God and He wouldn't let me die. My husband thought I was hallucinating (he is a physician, and I would have thought that too since I worked in a Cancer Center and used to never believe these stories). I recovered so quickly from the brain surgery - the neurosurgeons were perplexed how this could be.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: She remembers 'floating' through a tunnel-like thing.

arrival.other_being_detail: She identified the presence as God: 'an omnipotent being... Not like a person - much less limited in form.' She did not see God but felt him through her skin.

environment.environment_other_detail: She 'folded out into a huge room - not sure it was a room but it was a space.' It was 'brilliant and had a pink tinge.'

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: God asked if she had ever loved another person the way she was loved there, and told her: 'Mary, you can do better.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: She was 'very sick' and needed emergency brain surgery to 'clip an artery that was bleeding.'

person_demographics.occupation: Worked in a Cancer Center (also describes herself as providing extensive service/work).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: God 'held' her; she did not visually see God but sensed him through her skin; the space was brilliant with a pink tinge.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Light grew and encompassed her, then she floated through a tunnel-like passage and 'folded out' into a large brilliant pink-tinged space where she communicated with God and was told she could not stay, then returned/woke up.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The environment/light was described as having a 'pink tinge' (inspiration for her book title 'Is God Pink - Dying to Heal'). God was not seen visually but felt 'through my skin' and 'spoke through all of my senses.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Have you ever loved another person the way you have been loved here?” / “Mary, you can do better.”
